title: have a runny nose
content: 表示「流鼻水」。例：Leo stayed home because he had a runny nose and a cough.

title: the reason for + N / the reason why + 子句
content: 分別接名詞與完整子句，說明「……的原因」。例：Nobody knows the reason why the lights went out.

title: show／express regret for + N/V-ing
content: 對……表示後悔。例：He expressed regret for missing the family gathering.

title: make a will
content: 立遺囑。例：The lawyer advised him to make a will.

title: be high in + 成分
content: 表示「富含某種成分」。例：Beans are high in protein and fiber.

title: from time to time
content: 偶爾、不時。例：I still visit my elementary school from time to time.

title: sit on someone's knee(s)
content: 表示「坐在某人的膝上」。例：The child sat on her grandfather's knee during the story.

title: imagine + V-ing
content: 表示想像做某事，後接動名詞，不接 to + 原形動詞。例：Can you imagine living on a small island?

title: give sb sth / give sth to sb
content: 雙受詞句型；物品可直接放在人後，也可用 to 改寫。例：Mina gave her brother a card. = Mina gave a card to her brother.

title: since then
content: 從那時起，常與現在完成式搭配。例：We met in fifth grade and have been friends since then.

title: love to V / love V-ing
content: 兩者通常都表示「喜愛做……」；V-ing 較強調長期喜好。例：I love reading beside the window on rainy days.

title: kill two birds with one stone
content: 一舉兩得；用一個行動同時完成兩件事。例：Cycling to work lets Mia exercise and save money, killing two birds with one stone.

title: walk down the street
content: 表示「沿著街道走」。例：We walked down the street looking for the bookstore.

title: one...another...
content: 表示「一個……，另一個……」，後者通常是不特定的另一個。例：One guest ordered soup, and another chose salad.

title: use sth to V
content: 用某物來做某事。例：We use this app to record new vocabulary.

title: mention + N / V-ing / that 子句
content: 表示「提到……」，後面通常不加 about。例：Ella mentioned meeting you at the science fair.

title: lead / live a(n) + adj. + life
content: 過著某種生活。例：After retiring, they lived a quiet life by the sea.

title: the head of + 組織／部門
content: 表示「……的主管或領導人」。例：She became the head of the research department.

title: expense 與 expenses
content: expense 可指單筆費用；日常或營運開銷通常使用複數 expenses。例：The company reduced its travel expenses last year.

title: separate A from B
content: 表示「把 A 和 B 分開」。例：Please separate the white clothes from the colored ones.

title: be low in + 成分
content: 表示「某種成分含量低」。例：This soup is low in salt.

title: one of the all-time greats
content: 史上最傑出的人物之一。例：Many fans consider her one of the all-time greats in tennis.

title: for 與 because 表原因
content: for 作連接詞時較書面，通常接在主要子句後補充理由；because 可置於主要子句前或後，直接回答原因。例：We went inside, for the wind was getting stronger.

title: next to + N
content: 可表示「在……旁邊」；也可表示在喜好或重要性上「僅次於……」。例：Next to music, drawing is her favorite activity.

title: raise a family
content: 表示「養家、扶養孩子」。例：They worked hard to raise their family.

title: eat out / eat in
content: eat out 是外出用餐；eat in 是在家吃。例：We usually eat in on weekdays and eat out on Saturday.

title: in no time
content: 很快地、轉眼間。例：With everyone helping, the room was clean in no time.

title: television / TV 的冠詞
content: watch television／watch TV 表示看電視，通常不加冠詞；a television 指一台電視機。例：We bought a new television but rarely watch TV.

title: be useful for
content: 對某用途有幫助，後接名詞或 V-ing。例：This small brush is useful for cleaning keyboards.

title: make a discovery
content: 表示「有所發現、取得新發現」。例：The researchers made an unexpected discovery in the cave.

title: get + 形容詞
content: 表示「逐漸變得……」。例：The nights are getting colder.

title: turn into / turn A into B
content: turn into 是變成；turn A into B 是把 A 變成 B。例：The rain turned into snow, turning the road into ice.

title: personal space
content: 表示「個人空間」，包括身體周圍或具有私人性質的範圍。例：Please respect other people's personal space on the train.

title: body temperature / body language
content: 分別表示「體溫／肢體語言」。例：Her body language showed that she felt uncomfortable.

title: a gap between A and B
content: 表示 A 與 B 之間的差距、間隔或時間差。例：There is a six-year gap between the two buildings.

title: buy + 說法／藉口
content: 口語表示「相信、接受某人的說法」。例：I don't buy his excuse for missing the meeting.

title: refer to + N
content: 可表示「提到、指的是、查閱」。例：The word “they” refers to the two visitors.

title: the apple of one's eye
content: 表示「某人最珍愛的人或物」。例：Their youngest daughter is the apple of her grandfather's eye.

title: be all ears
content: 表示「洗耳恭聽、全神貫注地聽」。例：Tell me what happened—I'm all ears.

title: quite a few + 複數可數名詞
content: 表示「相當多、不少」，意思不是「很少」。例：Quite a few students joined the weekend workshop.

title: look like
content: 看起來像。例：That cloud looks like a rabbit.

title: stop + 人 + from V-ing
content: 表示「阻止某人做……」。例：Nothing could stop Mia from entering the competition.

title: milk + 牛／羊
content: 此處 milk 作動詞，表示「擠……的奶」。例：The farmer taught us how to milk a goat.

title: make a living
content: 表示「謀生、賺取生活所需」。例：She makes a living by designing websites.

title: drop off + 人／drop + 人 + off
content: 讓某人下車、順道送到某處；代名詞須放中間：drop her off。例：Dad dropped me off at the library.

title: get + 人 + 事物 / get + 事物 + for + 人
content: 表示「替某人取得或購買某物」。例：Could you get me a bottle of water?

title: in a low voice / be in a low mood
content: 分別表示「低聲地／情緒低落」。例：He answered in a low voice because the baby was sleeping.

title: share + N + with + 人
content: 表示「與某人分享……」。例：Nora shared her travel photos with the class.

title: live 的兩種讀音
content: 動詞 live /lɪv/ 表生活、居住；形容詞 live /laɪv/ 表現場的、活的。例：We live nearby and watched the live broadcast.

title: show 的節目與放映用法
content: 名詞 show 可指節目；動詞 show 可指電影上映。例：That talk show airs after the new film is shown.

title: go for a walk / drive
content: 表示「去散步／開車兜風」。例：Dad went for a walk after dinner.

title: come from + 地方／背景
content: 表示「來自……」。例：This tradition comes from a small village in Italy.

title: be faced with + N
content: 表示「面臨……」。例：The town is faced with a serious water shortage.

title: put up with
content: 忍受。例：I can’t put up with that loud noise anymore.

title: be full of ambition
content: 表示「充滿抱負、很有企圖心」。例：The young athlete is full of ambition and trains every day.

title: fruit 與 fruits
content: 泛指水果時通常不可數；強調不同種類或成果時可用 fruits。例：The project finally produced the fruits of years of research.

title: an approach to + N/V-ing
content: 處理某事的方法；to 是介系詞，後接名詞或動名詞。例：The school adopted a new approach to teaching science.

title: charge + 人 + for + N
content: 表示「向某人收取某項費用」。例：The hotel charged us extra for breakfast.

title: take place
content: 發生；舉行，主詞通常是事件或活動。例：The science fair will take place next Friday.

title: once + 子句
content: 表示「一旦／一……就……」，引導時間副詞子句；未來語境中的 once 子句通常用現在式。例：Once the rain stops, we will leave.

title: a way to V
content: 做某事的方法。例：Reading aloud is a good way to improve pronunciation.

title: be busy with + N / be busy V-ing
content: 分別表示「忙於某事／忙著做……」。例：Dad is busy preparing dinner.

title: food for thought
content: 表示「發人深省、值得仔細思考的事」。例：The documentary gave us plenty of food for thought.

title: reach a new low
content: 表示數值「降到新低」，也可指表現或行為「跌至新低點」。例：Temperatures reached a new low last night.

title: a solution for + 人 + to V
content: 讓某人得以做某事的解決方法。例：Flexible hours may be a solution for parents to balance work and family.

title: while 子句簡化為 while + V-ing
content: 副詞子句與主要子句主詞相同且為主動語態時，可刪除副詞子句主詞並將動詞改為 V-ing。例：While walking home, Mia listened to a podcast.

title: view A as B
content: 表示「把 A 視為 B」。例：Many people view mistakes as chances to improve.

title: head out
content: 出發、動身外出。例：We headed out before sunrise to avoid the heat.

title: spend + 時間 + V-ing
content: 花費時間做某事。例：Leo spent the afternoon preparing for the presentation.

title: even if 與 even though
content: even if 表假設「即使」；even though 表已知事實「雖然」。例：Even if it rains, we’ll go. Even though it rained, we went.

title: manage + N／manage to + V
content: manage 接名詞表示管理；manage to V 表示設法成功做到。例：She manages a small shop and manages to close it before seven every evening.

title: ask sb to V / ask for sth
content: ask sb to V 是請某人做事；ask for 是索取或尋求。例：I asked Ben to wait while I asked for help.

title: in person
content: 表示「親自、本人到場」，不是透過網路或他人。例：You must collect the certificate in person.

title: roll out + 產品／服務
content: 表示「正式推出新產品、服務或方案」。例：The company will roll out its new payment system next month.

title: get on / off a bus；by bus
content: 大型公共交通工具通常用 get on／off；by bus 表示交通方式。例：Get off the bus at the next stop.

title: sick / annual leave；take leave
content: leave 作不可數名詞指休假。例：She is on sick leave and will take annual leave next month.

title: 關係代名詞 + 插入語 + V
content: 可在 who／which 後插入 I think、I believe 等評論語；真正的主詞動詞關係仍屬於外層關係子句。例：Mia is the student who I believe can lead the team.

title: come to a close
content: 表示「結束、告一段落」。例：The summer festival came to a close at midnight.

title: hand + 人 + 事物 / hand + 事物 + to + 人
content: 表示「把某物遞給某人」。例：Please hand the receipt to the customer.

title: value one's friendship with + 人
content: 表示「珍惜與某人的友誼」。例：I truly value my friendship with Emma.

title: in short
content: 表示「簡言之、總之」。例：In short, the plan costs too much and takes too long.

title: prefer A over B
content: 表示「比起 B 更喜歡 A」。例：My brother prefers trains over buses for long trips.

title: make + 受詞 + 原形動詞
content: 使役結構，表示「使／迫使某人或某物做……」。例：The funny video made everyone laugh.

title: take + 人／事物 + seriously
content: 表示「認真看待……」。例：The manager takes every customer complaint seriously.

title: leave for + 地方
content: 動身前往某地。例：Our train leaves for Tainan at noon.

title: blow / wipe / pick one's nose
content: 分別表示「擤鼻涕／擦鼻子／挖鼻孔」。例：Please use a tissue to blow your nose.

title: yellow 作動詞
content: 表示「變黃」或「使……變黃」。例：Years of sunlight had yellowed the old newspaper.

title: boss + 人 + around
content: 表示「對某人頤指氣使、使喚來使喚去」。例：Stop bossing your teammates around.

title: find sb/sth + adj.
content: 認為或發現某人／某物具有某種狀態。例：I found the instructions confusing at first.

title: a platform for + 人 + to V
content: 表示「供某人做某事的平台」。例：The website provides a platform for artists to share their work.

title: tell sb (that) / tell sb about
content: tell sb (that) 後接告知內容；tell sb about 後接主題。例：Please tell me that you’re safe, and tell me about the trip later.

title: fall in love with + 人／事物
content: 表示「愛上……」。例：Leo fell in love with the quiet mountain town.

title: determine + N／wh-子句
content: 確定、查明某事；可接名詞或疑問詞子句。例：The test will determine whether the machine is safe.

title: take in + 風景／景象
content: 觀看並欣賞眼前的景色或事物。例：We stopped at the top of the hill to take in the view.

title: as a matter of fact / in fact
content: 事實上，用來補充或修正資訊。例：I thought he was new; in fact, he has worked here for years.

title: bring sb up
content: 養育某人；常用被動 be brought up。例：She was brought up by her grandparents.

title: be short of / on + N
content: 表示「缺少……；……不足」。例：We are short of chairs for tonight's meeting.

title: take sb/sth to + 地方
content: 帶某人或某物去某地。例：Could you take this package to the front desk?

title: give + 人 + a hand with + N
content: 表示「幫助某人做……」。例：Could you give me a hand with these boxes?

title: come up with + 想法／方案
content: 表示「想出、提出……」。例：The students came up with a clever solution.

title: get 表示「理解」
content: 口語中 get 可表示「聽懂、理解」；這個意思通常不用進行式。例：I understand the words, but I don't get the joke.

title: be important to + 人
content: 表示某人主觀上「重視……」。例：Spending time with family is important to me.

title: on hand
content: 在手邊、現成可用。例：Keep some medicine on hand during the trip.

title: go to bed / in bed / on the bed
content: go to bed 表示「去睡覺」；in bed 表示人在床上休息；on the bed 表示物品或人在床的表面。例：The jacket is on the bed, but Mia is already in bed.

title: wants and needs / for want of + N
content: wants and needs 表示「各種需求」；for want of 表示「因缺少……」。例：The project failed for want of enough funding.

title: be aware of + N / V-ing
content: 表示「知道、留意……」。例：Drivers should be aware of children crossing the road.

title: in the cold
content: 字面表示「處於寒冷環境中」；也能比喻「被排除在外、不知情」。例：The decision was made without us, leaving our team in the cold.

title: at the end of
content: 在……末尾／結束時。例：There is a short quiz at the end of each unit.

title: kid + 人 / be kidding
content: 作動詞表示「開某人的玩笑」；I'm kidding 表示「我在開玩笑」。例：Relax—I was only kidding.

title: sorry 的三種句型
content: be/feel sorry about + 事；be sorry that + 子句；be sorry to hear/see + 內容。例：I’m sorry to hear that your trip was canceled.

title: most 的冠詞規則
content: most 表「大多數」時通常不加 the；最高級 most 修飾名詞時要加 the。例：Most students chose the most practical plan.

title: make it to + 地方／活動
content: 表示「成功抵達或趕上……」。例：We made it to the station just before the train left.

title: 數量詞 + of + whom
content: 非限定關係子句中，先行詞為人時可用 some／many／most／all／none + of whom；不可改用 that。例：The club has twenty members, most of whom are students.

title: ship + 物品 + to + 地方
content: 此處 ship 作動詞，表示「運送、寄送」。例：The company ships its products to customers overseas.

title: hold on
content: 稍等；也可指抓牢。例：Hold on a moment while I check the schedule.

title: of one’s own 與 on one’s own
content: of one’s own 是某人自己的；on one’s own 是獨自或靠自己。例：She wants a room of her own and can clean it on her own.

title: once again
content: 再次、再度，常用於重新陳述或重複發生。例：Once again, the team checked every answer before submitting the form.

title: have time / take one’s time
content: have time 是有時間；take one’s time 是慢慢來、不必急。例：Take your time; we still have an hour.

title: 數字-year-old + 名詞
content: 作複合形容詞時 year 使用單數並加連字號。例：They have a six-year-old daughter.

title: pick up + 人／pick + 人 + up
content: 接某人、讓某人上車；若受詞是代名詞，必須放中間：pick him up。例：I will pick my sister up after school.

title: a sense of achievement
content: 表示「成就感」。例：Finishing the difficult project gave Leo a strong sense of achievement.

title: a good deal
content: 一筆划算的交易；便宜又值得購買的東西。例：This second-hand desk was a really good deal.

title: spill the beans
content: 表示「洩漏祕密、說溜嘴」。例：Don't spill the beans about the surprise party.

title: interact with + 人／事物
content: 表示「與……互動」。例：The children interacted with the robots during the exhibition.

title: require + 人 + to V
content: 表示「要求某人做……」。例：The school requires visitors to sign in at the office.

title: lay an egg
content: 表示鳥類等「下蛋」。例：The hen usually lays an egg in the morning.

title: connect A to B
content: 表示「將 A 與 B 連接或聯想在一起」。例：The bridge connects the village to the main road.

title: have a baby / be expecting a baby
content: 分別表示「生小孩／懷孕、即將有小孩」。例：The couple is expecting a baby this winter.

title: be open to + N
content: 表示「對……開放」，也可表示「願意接受……」。例：Our teacher is open to new ideas from the class.

title: begin to V / begin V-ing
content: 兩者多數情況都表示開始做某事。例：She began to laugh. = She began laughing.

title: come close to + N / V-ing
content: 表示「差一點……；幾乎達成……」。例：The team came close to winning the final game.

title: by the sea 與 by sea
content: by the sea 表示「在海邊」；by sea 表示「經由海路」。例：They live by the sea but usually travel by air.

title: be + 形容詞 + enough to V
content: 表示「足夠……而能做……」。例：Nina is tall enough to reach the top shelf.

title: stop by / stop in
content: 表示「順道短暫拜訪」。例：I'll stop by the bakery on my way home.

title: pause + N / pause to V
content: 可以表示「暫停某事」，也可表示「停下來去做另一件事」。例：Leo paused the video to answer the door.

title: be close to + 地方／人
content: 表示「距離近」或「與某人親近」。例：Our apartment is close to the train station.

title: look back to + 特定時間／事件
content: 表示「回想某個明確時間點或事件」。例：He looked back to the day he first visited the island.

title: be short for + 完整名稱
content: 表示「是……的縮寫或簡稱」。例：“Lab” is short for “laboratory.”

title: be driven by + N
content: 受……驅使、推動或影響。例：Her decision was driven by a desire to help others.

title: get in / out of a car；by car
content: 小型車輛通常用 get in／out of；by car 表示交通方式。例：We got out of the car and continued on foot.

title: by now
content: 表示「到目前為止、事到如今」，常搭配完成式或 should。例：The package should have arrived by now.

title: while 表時間與對比
content: while 可表示「當……時」或「然而」，需靠兩子句關係判斷。例：While I prefer tea, my brother drinks coffee.

title: a news / main / cover story
content: 分別表示「新聞報導／主要報導／封面故事」。例：The discovery became the newspaper's main story.

title: regular 與 regularly
content: regular 是形容詞，修飾名詞；regularly 是副詞，修飾動詞。例：Regular exercise helps people sleep better, so Mia exercises regularly.

title: for a while / once in a while
content: for a while 是一段時間；once in a while 是偶爾。例：Sit here for a while; I visit this park once in a while.

title: for one thing…, for another…
content: 用來依序提出兩個理由：一方面……，另一方面……。例：I chose the train; for one thing, it is safer, and for another, it is cheaper.

title: take place
content: 發生、舉行；通常不用被動語態。例：The school festival will take place next Friday.

title: have problems / difficulty V-ing
content: 做某事有困難，也可說 have a hard time V-ing。例：He has difficulty remembering names.

title: be interested in + N / V-ing
content: 表示「對……有興趣」，介系詞 in 後接名詞或動名詞。例：Lily is interested in learning about local history.

title: on average
content: 平均而言，通常放在句首或句尾。例：On average, the students read three books a month.

title: all alone / not … at all
content: all alone 是獨自一人；not…at all 是一點也不。例：She wasn’t nervous at all, even though she performed all alone.

title: practice + N / V-ing
content: 表示「練習或實行……」；接動作時使用 V-ing。例：We practiced speaking English before the presentation.

title: find out
content: 查明、弄清楚資訊。例：We need to find out when the last train leaves.

title: run into + 人
content: 表示「偶然遇見某人」。例：I ran into my former teacher at the night market.

title: be of (great) use
content: 很有用，語意相當於 be (very) useful。例：The checklist was of great use during the trip.

title: ask / answer a question
content: 提出／回答問題。例：Students may ask questions after the talk.

title: thank sb for N / V-ing
content: 因某事感謝某人。例：I thanked Leo for helping me carry the boxes.

title: get along with + 人
content: 表示「與某人相處融洽」。例：Tina gets along well with her new classmates.

title: show up
content: 出現、到場。例：Only eight players showed up for practice.

title: carry a risk／a risk of V-ing
content: 帶有風險；有做某事的風險。例：Driving while tired carries a serious risk.

title: again and again
content: 一再、反覆地。例：Leo practiced the difficult line again and again until it sounded natural.

title: the fruit(s) of + N
content: 比喻「……的成果、結果」。例：This exhibition is the fruit of months of preparation.

title: give in to
content: 向壓力、誘惑或某人屈服。例：Don’t give in to fear before the contest begins.

title: lose one's head
content: 表示「慌張、失去冷靜」。例：Ben lost his head when the alarm suddenly rang.

title: buy + 人 + 事物 / buy + 事物 + for + 人
content: 兩種結構都表示「買某物給某人」。例：Mia bought her brother a new backpack.

title: give to charity
content: 捐款或捐物給慈善機構。例：We gave our unused coats to charity.

title: work out sth / work sth out
content: 想出、解決某事。例：Let’s work out a fair schedule together.

title: can：助動詞與一般動詞／名詞
content: 助動詞 can 表能力或許可，後接原形動詞；一般動詞可指把食物裝罐，名詞指罐頭／罐子。例：She can swim, and she cans tomatoes every summer.

title: whistle to get someone's attention
content: 表示「吹口哨引起某人的注意」。例：Tom whistled to get his dog's attention.

title: house 作動詞
content: 提供住處、收容。例：The shelter can house thirty people overnight.

title: as + 身分／角色
content: 作介系詞，表示「以……的身分；作為……」。例：As the team leader, Ben must make the final decision.

title: sense + N／sense + that 子句
content: 感覺或察覺某事。例：I sensed that something had changed.

title: would like to V / feel like V-ing
content: would like to V 是想要做；feel like V-ing 是有做某事的心情。例：I’d like to rest, but I don’t feel like sleeping.

title: a piece of cake
content: 口語表示「非常容易的事」。例：The first puzzle was a piece of cake for Anna.

title: close with + N
content: 表示「以……作結」。例：The ceremony closed with a performance by the school band.

title: behind sb’s back
content: 在某人背後、瞞著某人。例：It is unfair to make decisions behind her back.

title: shake someone's hand
content: 表示「與某人握手」。例：The candidates shook hands before the debate.

title: go + 形容詞
content: 表示「變成某種狀態」，常用於不良或明顯變化。例：The bread went stale after being left outside.

title: give and take
content: 互相讓步、彼此妥協。例：Good teamwork requires patience and give and take.

title: or else
content: 表示「否則、要不然」，也可用於提出另一種可能。例：Leave now, or else you'll miss the last bus.

title: get home / get to + 地方
content: get home 不加 to；其他多數地點使用 get to。例：We got to the hotel after midnight and got home the next afternoon.

title: suit one's needs
content: 符合、適合某人的需求。例：You can adjust the schedule to suit your needs.

title: love at first sight
content: 表示「一見鍾情」。例：They said it was love at first sight.

title: lead a(n) + adj. + life
content: 過著某種生活。例：After retiring, they led a quiet life in the countryside.

title: milk and honey
content: 比喻富足、舒適而美好的生活；常見於 a land of milk and honey。例：Moving abroad does not guarantee a life of milk and honey.

title: ask + 人 + to a dance / ask + 人 + to dance
content: 前者表示「邀請某人參加舞會」，後者表示「邀請某人跳舞」。例：Ryan asked Zoe to dance with him.

title: ask sb out
content: 邀某人約會或一起外出。例：Ryan finally asked Maya out for coffee.

title: feed on + 食物
content: 表示動物「以……為食」。例：Many small birds feed on insects.

title: be about to V
content: 正要、即將做某事，通常指很快就會發生。例：The show is about to begin, so please take your seat.

title: stand in one’s way
content: 妨礙、阻擋某人。例：Don’t let one mistake stand in your way.

title: in the face of + N
content: 表示「面對……時；儘管有……」。例：The rescue team remained calm in the face of danger.

title: end up + V-ing
content: 最後結果竟然做了某事。例：We missed the bus and ended up walking home.

title: come across + 人／事物
content: 表示「偶然遇見、無意間發現」。例：I came across an old photograph while cleaning the attic.

title: also 與 too 的位置
content: also 通常放在一般動詞前、be 動詞後；too 通常放在句尾。例：Nora is a doctor and is also a writer.／Nora is a writer, too.

title: start a family
content: 通常表示夫妻「開始生育、組成有孩子的家庭」。例：The couple hopes to start a family in a few years.

title: a school of fish / whales
content: 一群魚／鯨魚。例：A school of silver fish swam beneath the boat.

title: recover + 失物／recover from + 狀況
content: recover 接物品表示尋回；recover from 表示從疾病、打擊或困境中恢復。例：The police recovered the stolen bike, and its owner soon recovered from the shock.

title: It’s sb’s turn to V
content: 輪到某人做某事。例：It’s your turn to choose the next song.

title: one another = each other
content: 互相、彼此。例：The teammates encouraged one another before the game.

title: 數字 + thousand / thousands of + N
content: 前面有明確數字時 thousand 不加 s；表示概數時用 thousands of。例：Two thousand tickets were sold within hours.

title: along the road
content: 表示「沿著道路」。例：Several small cafés stand along the road.

title: lose face
content: 表示「丟臉、失去顏面」。例：He refused to admit the mistake because he was afraid of losing face.

title: a shooting star
content: 表示「流星」。例：We saw a shooting star above the mountain.

title: come to a stop
content: 表示「停下來」。例：The bus slowly came to a stop beside the school.

title: with open arms
content: 表示「熱烈、誠摯地歡迎」。例：The host family welcomed the exchange student with open arms.

title: manage + 金錢／組織／工作
content: 表示「管理、經營或妥善處理」。例：Learning to manage your time can reduce stress.

title: to make a long story short
content: 表示「長話短說」。例：To make a long story short, we missed the final train.

title: one’s take on sth
content: 某人對某事的看法。例：What is your take on the new school rule?

title: across the street 與 cross the street
content: across the street 表示「在街道對面」；cross the street 表示「穿越街道」的動作。例：She crossed the street to visit the shop across from the bank.

title: open at + 時間 / open a meeting with + N
content: open 可表示「開始營業」，也可表示「開始會議或活動」。例：The chairperson opened the meeting with a short announcement.

title: just 的常見副詞義
content: 可表示剛剛、正好、只是或加強語氣，需依語境判斷。例：I just arrived. / This key is just what we need.

title: keep an eye on + 人／事物
content: 表示「留意、照看……」。例：Could you keep an eye on my bag for a minute?

title: because of + N / V-ing
content: because of 後接名詞、代名詞或 V-ing；because 後接完整子句。例：The game was delayed because of heavy rain.

title: from now on
content: 表示「從現在起」。例：From now on, I'll check my work more carefully.

title: all day / night long
content: 表示「整天／整夜一直……」。例：The neighbors' dog barked all night long.

title: track + progress/change
content: 追蹤進度或變化。例：This app helps students track their learning progress.

title: reflect on + N
content: 表示「認真回想、反思……」。例：At the end of the course, students reflected on what they had learned.

title: look / gaze / stare out of the window
content: 表示「往窗外看」；gaze 強調長時間凝視，stare 常帶有目不轉睛的感覺。例：She gazed out of the window at the falling snow.

title: have trouble + V-ing
content: 做某事有困難；意思接近 have difficulty V-ing。例：I had trouble finding the correct entrance.

title: information 是不可數名詞
content: 不可直接說 an information 或 informations；一則資訊可說 a piece of information。例：She gave me some useful information.

title: in the front of 與 in front of
content: in the front of 指某物內部前方；in front of 指某物外部前方。例：We sat in the front of the bus, in front of two teachers.

title: can't get enough of + N
content: 表示「非常喜愛……，怎麼都不嫌多」。例：My brother can't get enough of mystery stories.

title: a swarm of bees
content: 表示「一大群飛行中的蜜蜂」。例：A swarm of bees gathered near the old tree.

title: once 表示「曾經」
content: 表示過去某段時間曾有的狀態。例：This quiet street was once a busy market.

title: regard A as B
content: 表示「把 A 視為 B」。例：The villagers regard the old tree as a local treasure.

title: save / make / earn money
content: save money 是省錢或存錢；make/earn money 是賺錢。例：Nina cooks at home to save money, and tutors online to earn money.

title: be + 數字 + years old
content: 表示年齡。例：The museum is more than one hundred years old.

title: be known to + 人
content: 為某人或某群體所知。例：The story is known to children throughout the country.

title: encourage + 人 + to V
content: 鼓勵某人做某事。例：Our coach encouraged us to try again.

title: enough 的位置
content: 修飾名詞時放前面：enough time；修飾形容詞或副詞時放後面：old enough、quickly enough。例：The room is large enough for twenty people.

title: be combined with + N
content: 與……結合或混合。例：The sauce is combined with fresh herbs before serving.

title: back and forth
content: 來回地。例：The dog ran back and forth across the yard.

title: remind + 人 + to V
content: 表示「提醒某人做……」。例：Please remind Kevin to bring his library card.

title: fasten one's seat belt
content: 表示「繫好安全帶」。例：Please fasten your seat belt before the plane takes off.

title: meet one's needs
content: 滿足某人的需求。例：The program was redesigned to meet students' needs.

title: prefer to + 原形動詞
content: 表示比較喜歡或寧願做某事。例：I prefer to study in the library after school.

title: against one’s will
content: 違背某人的意願。例：No one should be forced to join against their will.

title: start to V / start V-ing
content: 兩者多數情況都表示開始做某事。例：It started to rain. = It started raining.

title: solve / face a problem
content: 解決／面對問題。例：We must face the problem before we can solve it.

title: one's bread and butter
content: 表示某人的「主要收入來源、賴以維生的工作」。例：Repairing computers is his bread and butter.

title: on foot
content: 表示「步行」。例：The station is close enough to reach on foot.

title: go back (to + 地方) / go back home
content: 回某地用 go back to；home 前不加 to。例：I went back to the store, then went back home.

title: only 的三種角色
content: 作副詞表示「僅僅」，作形容詞表示「唯一的」，作連接詞可表示「可是、只不過」。例：I wanted to join them, only I had to work.

title: air conditioning
content: 空調、冷氣系統。例：The air conditioning in our classroom is being repaired.

title: go on a trip / tour
content: 表示「去旅行／參加遊覽」。例：Our class went on a science tour during the winter break.

title: a good buy
content: 此處 buy 作名詞，表示「值得購買、價格划算的東西」。例：This winter coat was a good buy at half price.

title: place importance on sth
content: 重視某事。例：This school places great importance on independent reading.

title: like V-ing / like to V
content: 兩者都可表示喜歡；V-ing 常偏一般喜好，to V 可偏某次選擇或習慣。例：I like reading, but tonight I’d like to watch a film.

title: care for + 人
content: 此處表示「照顧、照料某人」。例：Nina stayed home to care for her grandmother.

title: sell + 人 + 事物 / sell + 事物 + to + 人
content: 兩種結構都表示「把某物賣給某人」。例：The farmer sold the restaurant fresh vegetables.

title: first thing (in the morning)
content: 一早第一件事；表示某事會優先處理。例：I’ll call the clinic first thing in the morning.

title: be known as + 身分／名稱
content: 以某個名稱或身分為人所知。例：The town is known as the flower capital of the region.

title: green energy
content: 綠色能源、低環境負擔的能源。例：The town plans to invest more in green energy.

title: hold a meeting
content: 舉行會議。例：The club will hold a meeting after lunch.

title: avoid + N / V-ing
content: 表示「避免……」；接動作時使用 V-ing，不能接 to V。例：Please avoid making loud noises in the hallway.

title: least 的冠詞規則
content: least 表最高級「最少的」修飾名詞時用 the；副詞用法依結構判斷。例：This route requires the least time.

title: book + 票券／房間／交通工具
content: 作動詞表示「預訂」。例：We booked a room near the train station.

title: on one’s way to
content: 在前往某地的途中。例：I bought some fruit on my way home.

title: book / reserve a table for + 人數
content: 表示「預訂幾人座的餐桌」。例：I'd like to reserve a table for six at seven o'clock.

title: one's love for + 人／事物
content: 表示「某人對……的愛或喜愛」。例：Her love for animals led her to become a vet.

title: stay out
content: 表示「待在外面、不回家」，常與時間搭配。例：You shouldn't stay out too late on a school night.

title: signal + 人 + to V
content: 表示「示意某人做……」。例：The guard signaled us to wait outside.

title: get down / fall to one's knees
content: 表示「跪下」；fall to one's knees 常帶有突然、懇求或筋疲力盡的語氣。例：The runner fell to his knees after crossing the finish line.

title: feel blue
content: 感到憂鬱、心情低落。例：Tina felt blue after her best friend moved away.

title: the rains
content: 複數 rains 常指某地區的「雨季、季節性降雨」。例：The roads become difficult to use when the rains arrive.

title: turn around / turn right / left
content: 轉身；右轉／左轉。例：Turn left at the light, then turn around at the gate.

title: put down = write down
content: 寫下、記下。例：Put down your ideas before you forget them.

title: take care of + 人／事物
content: 表示「照顧；負責處理」。例：Could you take care of my plants this weekend?

title: a ten-story building
content: story 也可表示建築物的「樓層」；作複合形容詞時使用單數。例：They work in a twelve-story building.

title: either A or B
content: 表示「A 或 B 其中之一」；A、B 應使用平行結構。例：You can either take the bus or walk home.

title: about 表大約
content: about + 數量／時間表示約莫。例：The walk takes about fifteen minutes.

title: hit the books
content: 口語表示「用功讀書」。例：I have an exam tomorrow, so I need to hit the books tonight.

title: belief about + N
content: 表示「對某件事的信念或看法」。例：Their beliefs about education are quite different.

title: appreciate + N/V-ing
content: 欣賞、感激某事；後接名詞或動名詞，不接 to + 原形動詞。例：I appreciate having a quiet place to study.

title: catch / get / have a cold
content: catch或get a cold 表示「感冒了」；have a cold 表示「正患感冒」。例：Sam caught a cold after the camping trip.

title: look back on + 一段時期／經歷
content: 表示「回顧某段經歷」。例：She looks back on her school days with gratitude.

title: make + 受詞 + 形容詞／名詞
content: 表示「使……變得……」或「使……成為……」。例：The good news made her happy.

title: in the sun
content: 表示「在陽光下」。例：Don't leave the medicine in the sun.

title: next + 時間與 the next + 時間
content: next Friday 表示以下一個星期五；the next day 表示某個過去或未來時間點的隔天。例：We arrived on Monday and left the next day.

title: still 的位置
content: 表「仍然」時，通常置於一般動詞前、be 動詞後。例：He still studies there. / He is still a student.

title: keep / bear + 事物 + in mind
content: 表示「把……牢記在心、納入考量」，常用來提醒。例：Keep the weather in mind when planning the trip.

title: at some point
content: 在某個時候、某一階段。例：At some point, every learner makes mistakes.

title: else 的位置
content: else 放在 someone、anything、where 等不定代名詞、疑問詞之後。例：Is there anything else you need?

title: big brother / sister
content: 口語中常表示「哥哥／姊姊」，但正式表達年齡關係通常用 older brother／sister。例：My older sister studies in Kaohsiung.

title: a real find
content: 名詞用法，指難得發現的好東西或好人選。例：This quiet café is a real find.

title: put in + 時間／心力
content: 表示「投入時間或心力」。例：The team put in months of work before the competition.

title: a story about / of + N
content: 表示「關於……的故事」。例：Grandma told us a story about her childhood.

title: food 與 foods
content: 泛指食物時通常不可數；指不同種類的食物時可用複數 foods。例：The market sells foods from several countries.

title: be drawn to + N
content: 受到……吸引。例：Many visitors are drawn to the town's peaceful atmosphere.

title: next 作副詞
content: next 可表示「接下來、下一步」，前面不需介系詞。例：Nobody knew what would happen next.

title: How come + S + V?
content: 口語「為什麼……？」後面用直述句語序，不倒裝。例：How come you are home so early?

title: a herd of cows
content: herd 是牛、象等群居大型動物的量詞，表示「一群牛」。例：A herd of cows crossed the country road.

title: duck down
content: 表示「迅速低頭或彎腰」，通常為了閃避。例：We ducked down when the ball flew toward us.

title: show respect to / for + 人／事物
content: 表示「對……表示尊重」。例：Students should show respect for different opinions.

title: appeal to + 人 / have appeal for + 人
content: 表示「對某人具有吸引力」。例：The simple design appeals to customers of all ages.

title: a large amount of + 不可數名詞
content: 大量的……；後面接不可數名詞，動詞通常配合 amount 使用單數。例：A large amount of water was wasted.

title: follow 的兩種理解義
content: follow instructions/signs 是遵循；can’t follow an explanation 是聽不懂。例：Follow the map, and tell me if you can’t follow my directions.

title: the moment／the instant／as soon as
content: 三者都可引導時間副詞子句，表示某事發生後另一件事立刻發生。例：As soon as the door opened, the children ran outside.

title: one of + 複數名詞
content: 表示「……之一」，of 後面的可數名詞使用複數。例：The waterfall is one of the natural wonders of the island.

title: be new to + 人
content: 表示某件事「對某人而言很陌生、不熟悉」。例：The software is still new to our team.

title: work for
content: 替某人或機構工作。例：My aunt works for a local newspaper.

title: be in the same boat
content: 表示「處於相同的困境或情況」。例：None of us understood the instructions, so we were all in the same boat.

title: become + adj. / noun
content: 表示變得……或成為……。例：The sky became dark, and Mia became the team leader.

title: satisfy one's desire for + N
content: 表示「滿足某人對……的渴望」。例：The quiet weekend satisfied her desire for peace.

title: go / turn red
content: 因害羞、生氣或熱而臉紅。例：His face turned red when everyone applauded him.

title: teach + 人 + how to V
content: 表示「教某人如何做……」。例：My uncle taught me how to fix a bicycle tire.

title: book a table / room / ticket
content: 此處 book 作動詞，表示「預訂」。例：We booked a table by the window for Saturday evening.

title: young at heart
content: 表示「心態年輕」。例：My grandfather is eighty but still young at heart.

title: on time 與 in time
content: on time 是準時；in time 是及時、趕在太晚之前。例：The bus arrived on time, and we reached the gate in time for boarding.

title: hand in + 事物 / hand + 事物 + in
content: 表示「繳交文件、作業等」。例：Students must hand in the form by Friday.

title: be fully booked
content: 表示「已被訂滿、沒有空位」。例：The hotel was fully booked during the holiday weekend.

title: have an eye for + N
content: 表示「對……有眼光、鑑賞力」。例：Tina has an eye for color and interior design.

title: a flight from A to B
content: 從 A 飛往 B 的航班。例：Our flight from Taipei to Seoul leaves at noon.

title: It is said that + 子句
content: 被動句型，表示「據說……」。例：It is said that the castle is over five hundred years old.

title: be good at + N / V-ing
content: 表示「擅長……」；接動作時使用 V-ing。例：My sister is good at solving logic puzzles.

title: not one's cup of tea
content: 表示「不是某人喜歡或擅長的事物」。例：Camping in heavy rain isn't my cup of tea.

title: call sth off
content: 取消某事。例：They called off the picnic because of the storm.

title: fail to + V
content: 表示「未能做成……」。例：Ryan failed to submit the form before noon.

title: a call for help
content: 求救聲或求援。例：We heard a call for help from the riverbank.

title: in that case / just in case
content: in that case 是既然如此；just in case 是以防萬一。例：It may rain; in that case, take this umbrella just in case.

title: be on display
content: 表示「正在展出、供人參觀」。例：Several student paintings are on display in the library.

title: at most
content: 至多、不超過。例：The repair will take two hours at most.

title: time sth to V
content: 安排某事在適當時間發生，以便達成目的。例：We timed our arrival to avoid the afternoon traffic.

title: turn on / off the television
content: 表示「打開／關掉電視機」。例：Please turn off the television before leaving.

title: one...the other...
content: 談論確定的兩個人或事物時，表示「一個……，另一個……」。例：I bought two notebooks; one is blue, and the other is green.

title: box up + 事物
content: 作動詞表示「把……裝箱」。例：We boxed up the books before moving.

title: between A and B / in between
content: between A and B 表兩者之間；in between 可單獨表示在中間。例：The pharmacy is between the bank and the café.

title: hit the road
content: 口語表示「上路、出發」。例：We should hit the road before traffic gets heavy.

title: ride a bicycle / by bicycle
content: ride a bicycle 表示騎乘動作；by bicycle 表示交通方式，前面不用冠詞。例：She goes to work by bicycle.

title: put on a happy / sad / poker face
content: 表示「刻意露出某種表情」。例：Although Mia was disappointed, she put on a cheerful face for the children.

title: leave sb/sth + adj.
content: 使某人或某物處於某狀態。例：Please leave the window open for a while.

title: small 的延伸義
content: 除了尺寸小，也可表示「年幼的、不重要的、輕微的」。例：One small error changed the final result.

title: be bad at + N / V-ing
content: 表示「不擅長……」。例：I'm bad at remembering people's names.

title: tell / read + 人 + a story
content: 表示「講／念故事給某人聽」。例：Dad reads the children a story every night.

title: green 作動詞
content: 表示使某地更綠、更環保。例：Volunteers planted native trees to green the school grounds.

title: beg for + N / beg + 人 + for + N
content: 表示「乞求、懇求得到……」。例：The child begged his father for one more story.

title: around the clock
content: 表示「日夜不停、全天二十四小時」。例：Doctors monitored the patient around the clock.

title: just 作形容詞
content: 表示公平、公正。例：Everyone deserves a just decision.

title: search for + 人／事物
content: 表示「尋找……」。例：Volunteers searched for the missing hiker until midnight.

title: and the like
content: 等等、諸如此類。例：The shop sells notebooks, pens, stickers, and the like.

title: daily task
content: 每日工作或日常任務。例：Checking customer messages is one of her daily tasks.

title: in a way / in some ways
content: in a way 是在某方面；in some ways 是在若干方面。例：In some ways, online classes are more flexible.

title: right now
content: 可表示「現在、此刻」，也可表示「馬上、立刻」。例：I need to speak with you right now.

title: stop to V 與 stop V-ing
content: stop to V 表示「停下原本的事，轉去做另一件事」；stop V-ing 表示「停止正在做的事」。例：We stopped to rest.／We stopped walking.

title: out of the blue
content: 出乎意料地、突然地。例：An old classmate called me out of the blue.

title: high 與 tall
content: high 常形容建築、位置或程度；tall 常形容人、樹木及直立物體的高度。例：The tower is very high, and the trees beside it are tall.

title: course 的不同義項
content: course 可指課程、路線、一道菜；作動詞可指液體快速流動。例：Tears coursed down her cheeks during the main course.

title: the moment + 子句
content: 表示「一……就……」，可放在主句前或後。例：The moment I heard the alarm, I left the building.

title: group … by …
content: 依某標準將事物分組。例：The teacher grouped the words by topic.

title: every now and then
content: 偶爾、間或。例：I enjoy a sweet drink every now and then.

title: at will
content: 隨意地、任意地。例：Members may enter the reading room at will.

title: call sb (up) / give sb a call
content: 打電話給某人。例：Give me a call when you reach the station.

title: look for work / look for a job
content: 找工作。例：He moved to the city to look for work.

title: one of the benefits of + N/V-ing
content: ……的好處之一；後面的主要動詞通常配合 one 使用單數。例：One of the benefits of walking is better sleep.

title: have difficulty + V-ing
content: 做某事有困難；difficulty 後接動名詞。例：She had difficulty understanding the instructions.

title: keep／stay in touch with + 人
content: 與某人保持聯絡。例：I still keep in touch with my elementary school teacher.

title: place an order (for sth)
content: 下訂單。例：Dad placed an order for two sandwiches online.

title: the number of 與 a number of
content: the number of + 複數名詞接單數動詞；a number of + 複數名詞接複數動詞。例：The number of visitors is rising, and a number of shops are expanding.

title: keep + adj. / keep (on) V-ing
content: keep + adj. 表保持狀態；keep (on) V-ing 表繼續做。例：Keep calm and keep trying.

title: get off to a good / poor start
content: 有好／不順利的開端。例：The team got off to a good start with an early goal.

title: at least
content: 至少。例：Please read at least ten pages tonight.

title: a solution to + N
content: ……的解決方法；介系詞通常用 to。例：We need a practical solution to the traffic problem.

title: get + 人／事物 + 形容詞
content: 表示「使某人或某物進入某種狀態」。例：The long delay got everyone worried.

title: once 表示「一次」
content: 表示次數。例：I have visited that museum only once.

title: hand down + 事物 / hand + 事物 + down
content: 表示「將物品、故事或傳統傳給下一代」。例：The recipe has been handed down through the family.

title: burst out laughing / burst into laughter
content: 表示「突然大笑起來」。例：Everyone burst out laughing when the dog stole the hat.

title: S + V, only to + V
content: 表示後來發生出乎意料、往往令人失望的結果，不表示目的。例：We hurried to the station, only to discover that the train had left.

title: chair a meeting
content: chair 作動詞表示「主持會議」。例：Ms. Lin will chair tomorrow's committee meeting.

title: take / catch hold of
content: 抓住。例：She took hold of the railing before stepping down.

title: take part in
content: 參加，相當於 participate in。例：More than fifty students took part in the contest.

title: while away + 時間
content: 消磨時間。例：We whiled away the rainy afternoon with board games.

title: go well / badly
content: 表示事情「進行順利／不順利」。例：The presentation went better than we expected.

title: head for / toward + 地方
content: 此處 head 作動詞，表示「朝……前進」。例：Dark clouds appeared, so we headed for home.

title: teach + 人 + about + 事物
content: 表示「教某人有關……的知識」。例：The guide taught us about the history of the temple.

title: change hands
content: 易手、轉由另一位擁有者持有。例：The old house has changed hands several times.

title: set a goal / set high goals
content: 表示「設定目標」。例：I set a goal of reading two English books this month.

title: color 作動詞
content: color 可表示「替……上色／染色」，也可表示某物變色。例：The children colored the map blue and green.

title: a bunch of bananas
content: 表示「一串香蕉」。例：Dad bought a bunch of bananas at the market.

title: slow down
content: 減速；放慢速度或步調。例：You should slow down when driving through the village.

title: use A as B
content: 把 A 當作 B 使用。例：They use the spare room as a study.

title: for some reason / for no reason
content: 分別表示「不知何故／無緣無故」。例：For some reason, my phone won't connect to the network.

title: think twice before + V-ing
content: 做某事前再三考慮。例：Think twice before sharing personal information online.

title: come to V
content: 表示「過來做某事」，to 後接原形動詞。例：Nora came to help us prepare the room.

title: focus on + N/V-ing
content: 專注於……；著重於……。例：The course focuses on improving speaking skills.

title: for the time being
content: 暫時、目前先如此。例：The library is closed, so we’ll study at home for the time being.

title: It is hard to V
content: 表示「做……很困難」。例：It is hard to concentrate when the room is noisy.

title: be known for + 特點／事物
content: 因某項特色而聞名。例：The restaurant is known for its fresh seafood.

title: 數字 + hundred / hundreds of + N
content: 前面有明確數字時 hundred 不加 s；表示概數時用 hundreds of。例：Three hundred guests attended, and hundreds of others watched online.

title: would like to + V
content: 禮貌表達「想要做……」，後面接原形動詞。例：We would like to reserve a table for four.

title: suffer from+疾病／痛苦
content: 受……之苦；遭受（疾病）。例：Jamie suffers from headaches.（Jamie 深受頭痛之苦。）

title: found + 組織／公司／機構
content: 此處是「創立、建立」，過去式和過去分詞都是 founded；不要和 find 的過去式 found 混淆。例：The sisters founded a small design studio together.

title: take on responsibility
content: 表示「承擔責任」。例：Eric is ready to take on more responsibility at work.

title: be in a bad mood
content: 表示「心情不好」。例：Dad was in a bad mood after losing his keys.

title: a method for + N/V-ing
content: 做某事的方法；for 後接名詞或動名詞。例：The teacher introduced a new method for remembering vocabulary.

title: take + 事物 + to heart
content: 表示「認真接受忠告」或「因別人的話而介意」。例：Mia took her coach's advice to heart and practiced harder.

title: step on someone's toes
content: 字面是「踩到某人的腳趾」；也可比喻「冒犯某人或干涉其職責」。例：I don't want to step on anyone's toes by changing the plan.

title: set an alarm for + 時間
content: 表示「把鬧鐘設定在某個時間」。例：I set an alarm for six thirty tomorrow morning.

title: have a hot temper
content: 表示「脾氣暴躁、容易生氣」。例：Although he has a hot temper, he calms down quickly.

title: keep track of + N
content: 表示「持續掌握、記錄……」。例：This app helps me keep track of my study time.

title: be curious about + N / wh-子句
content: 表示「對……感到好奇」。例：The children were curious about how the robot worked.

title: well 的詞性
content: 副詞表示做得好；形容詞表示身體健康；名詞可指井。例：She sings well but doesn’t feel well today.

title: keep one's head
content: 表示「保持冷靜」。例：Try to keep your head if something goes wrong.

title: have a … feel to it
content: 帶有某種感覺或氛圍。例：The small café has a warm, old-fashioned feel to it.

title: wear a smile / have a smile on one's face
content: 表示「面帶微笑」。例：Ella had a proud smile on her face after the performance.

title: play a(n) + adj. + role in + N/V-ing
content: 在……中扮演某種角色；in 後接名詞或動名詞。例：Exercise plays an important role in keeping the heart healthy.

title: reach a new high
content: 表示數量、價格或程度「創新高」。例：Ticket sales reached a new high this month.

title: earn one’s keep
content: 賺取生活費、靠工作養活自己。例：He worked weekends to earn his keep.

title: take back + N / take + N + back
content: 表示「拿回、送回」。受詞是代名詞時放中間：take it back。例：She took the damaged lamp back to the shop.

title: play a part / role in
content: 在……中扮演角色、發揮作用。例：Sleep plays an important part in learning.

title: question 作動詞
content: 可表示盤問，也可表示質疑。例：The reporter questioned whether the plan was realistic.

title: knock on / answer the door
content: 分別表示「敲門／去應門」。例：Someone knocked on the door, but nobody answered it.

title: when 子句的被動簡化
content: 副詞子句為被動語態時，可省略重複主詞及 be 動詞，保留過去分詞。例：When asked about the mistake, he apologized immediately.

title: take / do the minutes
content: 表示「做會議紀錄」。例：Karen volunteered to take the minutes at today's meeting.

title: think that / think about / think of
content: think that 後接看法；think about 表仔細考慮；think of 可指想到或對……有何看法。例：Think about the choices before you decide.

title: Money doesn’t grow on trees.
content: 錢得來不易；提醒人不要任意浪費。例：Think before buying another game—money doesn’t grow on trees.

title: as + 子句：當……時
content: 作連接詞，表示兩件事同時發生。例：As the sun went down, the air became cooler.

title: then 作形容詞
content: 放在名詞前表示「當時的」。例：The then principal introduced the new library plan.

title: a big day / decision
content: big 可表示「重要、影響重大」，不只是尺寸大。例：Choosing a university is a big decision.

title: old / elderly / former / previous
content: old 可指年老或使用已久；elderly 專指年長者；former 指以前的身分；previous 指時間或順序上的前一個。例：I met a former teacher at my previous workplace.

title: heavy / light / pouring rain
content: 分別表示「大雨／小雨／傾盆大雨」。例：We waited inside until the pouring rain stopped.

title: make / drive + 人 + crazy
content: 表示「把某人逼瘋、使某人非常惱怒」。例：That repeated buzzing sound is driving me crazy.

title: want to V / want + 人 + to V
content: 分別表示「想做……／想要某人做……」。例：I want you to check this answer again.

title: go bad
content: 表示食物「腐壞、變質」。例：The yogurt will go bad if it isn't refrigerated.

title: pen + 信件／文章／詩
content: pen 作動詞是較正式或文學性的「撰寫」。例：The singer penned several songs for the new album.

title: in one's head
content: 表示「在某人的腦中、心裡」。例：I kept repeating the address in my head.

title: worry about + N/V-ing
content: 擔心……。例：She worries about arriving late for class.

title: be burned into one's memory
content: 表示某段重大或強烈的經歷「深深烙印在記憶中」。例：The sight of the flooded town was burned into his memory.

title: long to V / long for + N
content: 表示「渴望做……／渴望得到……」。例：After months abroad, he longed to see his family again.

title: when it rains, it pours
content: 字面是「一下雨就下傾盆大雨」，比喻壞事接二連三發生，即「禍不單行」。例：My laptop broke after I lost my phone—when it rains, it pours.

title: cry out for help / let out a cry
content: 分別表示「大聲呼救／發出一聲叫喊」。例：The injured climber cried out for help.

title: go + V-ing
content: 常用於戶外、休閒或體育活動。例：We went cycling along the river last Sunday.

title: either A or B 的主詞動詞一致
content: 連接兩個主詞時，動詞通常配合距離較近的主詞。例：Either the teachers or the principal is attending the meeting.

title: honey 作親暱稱呼
content: 可用來稱呼伴侶或孩子，類似「親愛的、寶貝」。例：Honey, could you help me carry these bags?

title: There is no question about / of
content: 毫無疑問。例：There is no question about her ability to lead the team.

title: arm + 人 + with + 事物
content: 表示「為某人配備武器、工具或知識」。例：The course arms students with practical communication skills.

title: pie in the sky / castles in the air
content: 都可表示「不切實際的夢想或計畫」。例：Without enough funding, the proposal may remain pie in the sky.

title: nod / shake one's head
content: 分別表示「點頭／搖頭」。例：Leo shook his head when I asked whether he agreed.

title: make / shoot a film
content: 表示「拍攝電影」。例：The director plans to shoot the film in Taiwan.

title: foot the bill
content: 表示「負擔費用、買單」。例：The company agreed to foot the bill for the business dinner.

title: draw + 人 + into / to + 地方
content: 表示「吸引某人進入或前往某處」。例：The smell of coffee drew several customers into the shop.

title: go by
content: 用於時間，表示「流逝、過去」。例：The afternoon went by quickly while we were talking.

title: a big cheese
content: 口語表示「有權勢或重要的人物」。例：Her uncle is a big cheese in the advertising business.

title: a table / chair leg
content: leg 除了人的腿，也能表示桌椅等家具的「腳」。例：One leg of the wooden chair is loose.

title: bring sb sth / bring sth to sb
content: 雙受詞句型；把某物帶給某人。例：Please bring me the form. = Please bring the form to me.

title: keep up with
content: 跟上進度或速度。例：I review every night to keep up with the class.

title: It is useless to V
content: 做某事沒有用。例：It is useless to argue after the decision is final.

title: hot 的常見延伸義
content: 除了「炎熱、辛辣」，hot song／hot issue 可表示「熱門歌曲／熱門議題」。例：Online privacy has become a hot issue.

title: in the course of
content: 在……過程中，相當於 during。例：He learned a lot in the course of the project.

title: hard to say
content: 表示「很難判斷、難以斷言」。例：It's hard to say which plan will cost less.

title: wait / hold on a minute
content: 表示「請稍等一下」。例：Hold on a minute while I find the document.

title: connect with + 人
content: 與某人建立連結、良好關係或產生共鳴。例：The new student quickly connected with her classmates.

title: be responsible for + N / V-ing
content: 表示「負責……」。例：Mia is responsible for checking the equipment each morning.

title: organize + 活動／事件
content: 表示「籌辦、安排活動」。例：The students organized a charity sale at school.

title: at sb’s place
content: 在某人家裡。例：We are meeting at Jason’s place after dinner.

title: want 通常不用進行式
content: want 表示「想要、需要」時屬於狀態動詞，通常說 I want，不說 I am wanting。例：I want a glass of water.

title: as + 子句：因為……
content: 作連接詞，說明原因，語氣通常比 because 輕。例：As the road was blocked, we chose another route.

title: save a dance for + 人
content: 表示「保留一支舞給某人」。例：Will you save the last dance for me?

title: reason that + 子句 / reason with + 人
content: reason that 表示「推論……」；reason with 表示「與某人講道理」。例：We tried to reason with him, but he refused to listen.

title: laugh at 與 laugh about
content: laugh at 常表示「嘲笑某人／某事」；laugh about 表示「因某件事而笑、拿某事說笑」。例：It's unkind to laugh at someone else's mistake.

title: star in + 作品 / star + 演員
content: star in 表示「主演某作品」；作品作主詞時，star 可表示「由某人主演」。例：The film stars several young actors.

title: go to see a movie / go to the movies
content: 兩者都表示「去看電影」；go to the movies 常泛指去電影院。例：We're going to the movies after dinner.

title: be made of 與 be made from
content: be made of 用於仍看得出原料；be made from 用於原料經加工後難以辨認。例：The chair is made of wood, while paper is made from wood.

title: 數量詞 + of + which
content: 非限定關係子句中，先行詞為事物時可用 some／many／most／all／none + of which；不可改用 that。例：She borrowed five books, two of which were about space.

title: roughly + 數字
content: 表示大約、約莫，語氣較口語。例：The journey takes roughly two hours.

title: call a meeting
content: 召開會議。例：The coach called a meeting after practice.

title: hard 作形容詞與副詞
content: 可表示「堅硬的、困難的」，也可作副詞表示「努力地、猛烈地」。例：It rained hard while we were driving home.

title: emotional support
content: 表示「情感上的支持」。例：Close friends can provide emotional support during difficult times.

title: give + 人 + a smile / smile at + 人
content: 兩種結構都可表示「對某人微笑」。例：The nurse smiled at the nervous child.

title: walk a dog / take a dog for a walk
content: 兩種說法都表示「遛狗」。例：Ella takes her dog for a walk before breakfast.

title: be crazy to V / be crazy about + N
content: be crazy to V 表示「做……很荒唐」；be crazy about 表示「非常迷戀……」。例：My sister is crazy about Korean dramas.

title: keep up with + N
content: 表示「持續掌握、跟上……」。例：Dad reads the news every morning to keep up with world events.

title: It is important for + 人 + to V
content: 表示「某人做……很重要」。例：It is important for children to get enough sleep.

title: work 的延伸義
content: 機器 work 表運作，方法 work 表有效；複數 works 可指作品。例：The printer works, and the artist’s latest works are upstairs.

title: come in first / second / third place
content: 比賽獲得第一／二／三名。例：Our class came in second place in the relay.

title: keep one's fingers crossed
content: 表示「祈求好運、希望事情順利」。例：Keep your fingers crossed for our team tomorrow.

title: take a taxi / train / bus
content: 搭乘交通工具；冠詞依交通工具而定。例：We took a train to Hualien.

title: be eager to + 原形動詞
content: 渴望、迫切想做某事。例：The children were eager to see the new animals.

title: It takes sb + 時間 + to V
content: 表示某人花多少時間做某事。例：It takes Kai twenty minutes to walk to school.

title: the young
content: the + 形容詞可表示一群人；the young 指「年輕人」，視為複數。例：This program creates new opportunities for the young.

title: find meaning in + N / V-ing
content: 表示「在……之中找到意義」。例：He finds meaning in helping younger students.

title: press a button
content: 表示「按下按鈕」。例：Press the green button to start the machine.

title: cry over / about + N
content: 表示「因……而哭泣或難過」。例：There's no need to cry over one small mistake.

title: all over again
content: 從頭再來、全部重做。例：The file was damaged, so we had to type the report all over again.

title: have a go at + N / V-ing
content: 表示「嘗試做……」。例：Let me have a go at repairing the bicycle.

title: be green with envy
content: 非常嫉妒、眼紅。例：Ben was green with envy when he saw the new bicycle.
